svg.title: منيو فالح — الصفحة الثانية — A4
svg.desc: Fully vector menu page with named layers. Plates are redrawn with small, medium, and large prices; four appetizer items removed as requested. Cairo Bold item names; Cairo ExtraBold section headings.
